accumulativeDividendOf(address).details: accumulativeDividendOf(_owner) = withdrawableDividendOf(_owner) + withdrawnDividendOf(_owner) = (magnifiedDividendPerShare * balanceOf(_owner) + magnifiedDividendCorrections[_owner]) / magnitude

params._owner: The address of a token holder.

returns._0: The amount of dividend in wei that `_owner` has earned in total.

addLockedAmount(address,uint256).details: This function can only be called by the LockManager.

params.amount: The amount of locked amount to be added.
params.holder: The address of the holder to add locked amount to.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

burn(uint256).details: This function overrides the burn function of the ERC20 standard. It includes checks for vesting, launch status, and developer lock.

params.amount: The amount of tokens to burn.

burnFrom(address,uint256).details: Destroys a `value` amount of tokens from `account`, deducting from the caller's allowance. See {ERC20-_burn} and {ERC20-allowance}. Requirements: - the caller must have allowance for ``accounts``'s tokens of at least `value`.

calculateHolderVestingPostMigration(addr.details: This is utility function, for getting the unlock time and amount before it's available via holdersVesting(address).

params.holder: The address of the holder to check.

returns.amount: The amount of tokens that the holder has vested post-migration.
returns.unlockTime: The unlock time after migration to UniswapV3 pool.

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the default value returned by this function, unless it's overridden. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

distributeDividends().details: This function can be called by anyone to distribute dividends.

extendLockDuration(address,uint256).details: This function can only be called by the owner.

params._holder: The holder whose lock duration is to be extended.
params._newUnlockTime: The new unlock time to be set, if it is greater than the current unlock time.

initialize(string,string,bytes,address,b.details: Initializes the BurnableToken contract. This function can be called only by the owner of the contract.

params._dev: The address of the developer (creator) of the token.
params._isDevLocked: Boolean indicating if the developer's address is locked.
params._lockManagerImpl: The address of the lock manager implementation contract.
params._lockPositionsNFTImpl: The address of the lock positions NFT implementation contract.
params._metadata: The metadata of the token, which can include additional information such as description, image URL, etc.
params.addressChecker: The address of the IAddressChecker contract.

params.amount: Amount of tokens to lock. Must be greater than 0 and pre-approved to transfer.
params.durationInDays: Duration of the lock in days. Caps at 365 days. Must be greater than 0.

returns.tokenId: - The tokenId of the minted position NFT.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setDev(address).details: This function can only be called by the current developer and after the token has been launched.

params._dev: The address of the new developer(creator).

setLaunched().details: This function can only be called by the owner.

setMigrated(uint256).details: This function can only be called by the owner.

params.liquidityAmount: The amount of tokens, that were used for liquidity on migration.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: This function overrides the transfer function of the ERC20 standard. It includes checks for vesting, launch status, and developer lock.

params.to: The address to which tokens are transferred.
params.value: The amount of tokens to transfer.

returns._0: A boolean indicating whether the transfer was successful.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: This function overrides the transferFrom function of the ERC20 standard. It includes checks for vesting, launch status, and developer lock.

params.from: The address from which tokens are transferred.
params.to: The address to which tokens are transferred.
params.value: The amount of tokens to transfer.

returns._0: A boolean indicating whether the transfer was successful.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._owner: The address of a token holder.

returns._0: The amount of dividend in wei that `_owner` can withdraw.

params._owner: The address of a token holder.

returns._0: The amount of dividend in wei that `_owner` has withdrawn.

accumulativeDividendOf(address).notice: View the amount of dividend in wei that an address has earned in total.

addLockedAmount(address,uint256).notice: Adds locked vesting amount for a holder.

burn(uint256).notice: Burns a specified amount of tokens from the caller's balance.Prior to the burn, the accumulated dividends are distributed to the caller.

calculateHolderVestingPostMigration(addr.notice: Calculates the unlock time and the amount of tokens vested post-migration for the holder. Transfers to the LockManager (for locking) are exempt from this.

distributeDividends().notice: Distributes dividends to all token holders.

extendLockDuration(address,uint256).notice: Extends the lock duration of a holder. This blocks the holder from all tranfers for a specified amount of time, except for transfers made to the LockManager (if the token has migrated).

holdersVesting(address).notice: Returns the total amount of tokens locked for the holder, until vested, the unlock time (pre and post migration) and the amount of tokens locked post-migration in the LockPositionsNFT(of the total amount of tokens locked for vesting).

isLaunched().notice: Checks if the token is launched.

lock(uint256,uint256).notice: Locks the selected position and mints a LockPositionsNFT representing the lock, to the caller (msg.sender).Uses LockManager. For the other functions, see the ILockManager interface.

setDev(address).notice: Changes the address of the developer(creator) for the token.The new address can be set to the zero address, which effectively removes the developer.

transfer(address,uint256).notice: Transfers tokens from the caller to a specified address.Prior to the transfer the accumulated dividends are distributed to the caller.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: Transfers tokens from 'from' to 'to'. Must be approved by 'from'.Prior to the transfer the accumulated dividends are distributed to the holder ('from').

withdrawDividend().notice: Withdraws the ether distributed to the sender.

withdrawableDividendOf(address).notice: View the amount of dividend in wei that an address can withdraw.

withdrawnDividendOf(address).notice: View the amount of dividend in wei that an address has withdrawn.
